body:
Resolve Wave 5 audit findings:
1. Run 'npm run build' to rebuild:
   - dist/agb.mjs
   - dist/mcp-server.mjs
   - dist/hooks/pre-tool-use.bundle.mjs
2. Run 'node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs' to regenerate all reference docs from CLI and CHANGELOG.md.
3. Run 'npm test' and assert 100% pass across all tests.
4. Verify bundle externals with 'node scripts/check-bundle-externals.mjs'.

Verification: npm run build && node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs --check && npm test
title: Wave 5: Rebuild Bundles, Generate References, and Verify Release Audit
